sealed_story_packet.headline: OpenAI pairs small-business AI workflows with local human coaching
verified_visual_facts: A small team chooses one real recurring workflow for an AI trial.
A local advisor provides hands-on guidance and follow-up.
The team tests the workflow, reviews the result and measures usefulness.
The process iterates or stops based on observed value.
